recipe.title: Join me next week! NYC Cookbook Event - Love and Lemons
recipe.description: Hey, NY friends – what are you doing next Thursday? If you’re free, come meet me between 5-7pm at Anthropologie at Chelsea Market. I’d love to see you and say hi! I’ll be signing cookbooks and there will be snacks. The event is free, but RSVP HERE. See you there 🙂
